questions.question: When the Ziphites told King Saul where David was hiding, what did David first ask God to do in his song?
When David begged God to hear his prayer in a song, what danger was he facing?

answers.text: Ruthless men were out to take his life
His own family had turned against him
He had fallen sick and could not get up

questions.question: David wrote that God had left him to face the ruthless men who sought his life alone. True or false?
David, hunted by King Saul, ended his song of praise by saying what God had done for him. What was it?

answers.text: Made him king over all Israel
Gave him a city of his own
